name: v0.14.0
body: ## 🚀 Features ### `calf-ui` * Add a cross-platform `selectableDates` rule to `AdaptiveDatePicker`, with `DateBounds(minDateMillis, maxDateMillis)` and an infix `and` to combine rules. Rejected days are greyed out on Material and on the iOS 16+ calendar by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/541 * Add `AdaptiveCompactDatePicker`, a date field that opens the calendar on tap (Material `DatePickerDialog`, native compact `UIDatePicker` on iOS) and shares `AdaptiveDatePickerState` with the inline picker by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/543 * Add `AdaptiveDateRangePicker` with `AdaptiveDateRangePickerState` (Material3 `DateRangePicker`, native multi-date `UICalendarView` on iOS 16+) by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/544 ### `calf-io` * Add `KmpFile.source()` to stream a picked file as a kotlinx-io `RawSource` without loading it into memory. Android content URIs from the Storage Access Framework, Google Drive or Downloads stream directly, and okio users can convert with `kotlinx-io-okio` by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/545 ## 🐛 Fixes ### `calf-ui` * Allow a single-button `AdaptiveAlertDialog`: `dismissText` is now optional, and a null or blank value drops the dismiss button on every platform by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/539 ### `calf-file-picker` * Reuse the identical cached native library instead of replacing it, fixing the Windows DLL lock when two apps bundle the picker by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/540 ## 📦 Dependencies * Bump Kotlin to 2.4.20, Compose Multiplatform to 1.12.0 and Material3 to 1.12.0-alpha03 by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/546 * Migrate to AGP 9.4.0 with the `com.android.kotlin.multiplatform.library` plugin, compileSdk 37 and Gradle 9.7.1 by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/546 * Bump Coil to 3.6.2, Ktor to 3.5.2 and kotlinx-datetime to 0.8.0 by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/546 * `calf-io` now exposes kotlinx-io 0.9.1 as an `api` dependency by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/545 ## ⚠️ Notes * Calf 0.14.0 targets Kotlin 2.4.20 and Compose Multiplatform 1.12.0, see the [compatibility table](https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf#compatibility). * Android artifacts are built against compileSdk 37. The library minSdk stays 23. ## Demo: `AdaptiveCompactDatePicker` 🆕 | `AdaptiveDateRangePicker` 🆕 :-------------------------:|:-------------------------: | **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/compare/v0.13.0...v0.14.0

name: v0.11.0
body:
## 🚀 Features

### `calf-ui`
* Expose iOS-native styling customization for AdaptiveNavigationBar (UITabBar) and AdaptiveTopBar (UINavigationBar) by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/499

### `calf-file-picker`
* Integrate a native library for file picker functionality across desktop platforms using JNI bridge instead of the old JNA implementation by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/477
* Introduce file picker settings and improve customization options by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/480
* Support `maxItems` limit for multiple file selection by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/483
* Introduce context-free KmpFile extension functions by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/486
* Add ImageRepresentationMode to FilePickerSettings to control iOS asset representation mode by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/492
* Add initial directory support for folder picker and improve MIME type mapping on Android by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/493
* Add FileSaverLauncher for cross-platform file saving support by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/494

### `calf-webview`
* Add KVO observer for WKWebView to enhance progress tracking and state updates by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/466

### `sample`
* Workflow for automating deployments to Netlify by @deshkaustubh in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/439
* Add ShowcaseScreen in sample by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/465
* Add macOS JVM args to configure system appearance by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/475

## 🐛 Fixes

### `calf-file-picker`
* Fix the desktop file picker first launch latency by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/479
* Android: Add fallback to document picker for unsupported media picker scenarios by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/482
* Fix: use `PHPickerConfigurationAssetRepresentationModeCompatible` for better image compatibility on iOS by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/491
* iOS: Provide KmpFile.url as a persistent copy of the picked file and add new KmpFile.originalUrl the original URL returned by the file picker by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/496

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0

## What's Changed
* Add meta viewport setting in sample for better user experience on mobile devices by @jershell in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/73
* Add a Coil utils module and a KmpFileFetcher to load file picker images with coil easily by @iruizmar in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/84

* Create iOS temp file in documents file picker by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/86

> The `NSURL` returned by iOS `PHPicker` is a url for a file that's going to be deleted after the file picker callback so you won't be able to store `KmpFile` and use it later for upload or something else, that's why now we create a temp file in iOS to solve this issue.

* Update Compose to 1.6.0 by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/59
* Update Kotlin to 1.9.22 by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/59
* Update AGP to 8.2.2 by @MohamedRejeb in https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/59

## ❌ Breaking changes
### `calf-file-picker`
* In Android KmpFile is `wrapper` around `Uri` instead of `File`.
* `KmpFile` extension functions now require a `PlatformContext` that you can get from `LocalPlatformContext.current`
* `KmpFile.readByteArray` is changed to a suspend function.
```kotlin
val context = LocalPlatformContext.current

val singlePickerLauncher =
    rememberFilePickerLauncher(
        onResult = { files ->
            scope.launch {
                files.forEach {
                    try {
                        it.readByteArray(context).toImageBitmap()
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                    }
                }
            }
        },
    )
```
